subject: prin-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.------AFI.------COS.P.
description: Chart on book p. 220 (T(IMP)M-18). PRIN-INFO (the title writes PRI.INFO.) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. The line from the subject bends at AFI and runs on to COS-P (cosmic particulars), the third code of the title. From COS-P: CULT-INFO-FO. From CULT-INFO-FO: PHY-U-C (physical universe context). RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is on a dotted line from CULT-INFO-FO. From RT-INT-TR: INTR (interpretation). CULT-INFO-FO and INTR both have the (PO) prefix, "point of".
